svg.aria-label: The path we tested on AWS. The AgentForEach brain calls the AgentCore Runtime data plane over HTTPS with SigV4, using a session id derived from a hash of the user id. AgentCore routes each session to its own Firecracker microVM, restored from one prepared snapshot, running a small adapter on port 8080 in front of the unchanged sandbox server on port 8081. Session storage at /mnt/data is a 1 GB network filesystem kept for 14 days idle and wiped on a runtime version update. In PUBLIC mode egress is fully open, including raw TCP; in VPC mode only what your routes and security groups allow.
